_README: Cassette for the f-m2-12 LLM debate end-to-end happy path. Three round transcripts (Claude, Gemini, Grok) replayed deterministically through llm_debate.run_debate. No live network ever — the test wraps these into invoke callables.

claude.text: {"letter_grade": "B", "rationale": "Gemini's A- is too generous. The open-label P3 design and PFS-only primary endpoint introduce material bias risk that Gemini's rationale glossed over. The on-mechanism PD signal is encouraging but not sufficient to override these design risks. Net: lower than Gemini's A-."}

gemini.text: {"letter_grade": "B+", "rationale": "Claude's critique on PFS-only and open-label has merit but overstates the bias risk: the comparator (docetaxel) is well-characterised and the alpha-spending plan is defensible. Replicated P2 ORR + on-mechanism PD response still support an above-base-rate read. Revised down from A- to B+."}

grok.text: {"final_grade": "B+", "rationale": "Adjudicating: Gemini's revised B+ position better integrates Claude's design-risk critique without overweighting it. Replicated P2 efficacy and clean sponsor track record support the above-base-rate grade. Final: B+."}
